reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that enables an agent to operate an existing signed-in Chrome profile through an approved and session-scoped browser control bridge.

summaries.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体在用户授权下控制现有的 Chrome 配置文件，执行浏览、页面交互、截图、上传和状态验证等任务。
summaries.en: Enables DeepSeek Harness agents to control an existing Chrome profile with user authorization for browsing, page interaction, screenshots, uploads, and state verification.

capabilities: Controls an existing signed-in Chrome profile
Reads and interacts with browser tabs and page content
Performs clicks, text entry, scrolling, screenshots, uploads, and page evaluation
Can open and close agent-created tabs
Uses per-session authorization and approval controls
